title: Disha Voice benchmark run record
description: Machine-readable contract for one benchmark run, as defined by RESEARCH/benchmark-plan.md. A run records only measurements that were actually produced. A measurement that was not collected is recorded as status 'not_collected' with a reason, never as a zero, an 'N/A', or a guessed value. Every object closes additionalProperties so a stray or invented field fails validation instead of passing silently. Never record a phone serial, IMEI, user speech, camera capture, or any other personal data in this record.

$schema.description: Optional. A record may declare the schema it follows, as JSON Schema instances conventionally do.

$id.description: Optional identifier for the record itself.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to. Bump on any breaking change to field names, types, or required keys.

protocolVersion.description: Version of RESEARCH/benchmark-plan.md that this run followed. A run is comparable only when the measured scope and relevant artifacts/conditions match.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this run. Use the same value across every repeat inside the run.

capturedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp at which the run record was captured.

commit.description: Full or abbreviated git commit the run was executed from.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree was dirty at run time. Do not compare dirty and clean runs as if identical.

remote.description: Optional remote the commit was taken from.

os.description: Host operating system name and version.

arch.description: Host CPU architecture, e.g. x86_64 or aarch64.

powerMode.description: Host power mode during the run, e.g. 'AC', 'battery', 'unknown'.

jdkVersion.description: JDK vendor and version used, e.g. 'Temurin 17.0.x'. Keep fixed across compared runs.

gradleVersion.description: Gradle version used, e.g. '8.14.3'. Use the committed wrapper distribution, not a scratch installation.

tools.description: Every external tool whose output contributed to this record, with its version.

commands.description: Exact commands executed, in order, including repeats.

apks.description: APK artifacts produced by this run. One entry per file. Do not silently treat one split as the complete install.

path.description: Path of the APK file, relative to the repository root.

split.description: Split name, e.g. 'config.arm64_v8a', or 'none' for a universal APK.

bytes.description: Exact file size in bytes from the file system.

measuredWith.description: Tool and version used to measure the size and hash.

downloadSizeEstimateBytes.description: Optional apkanalyzer 'apk download-size' estimate. It is an estimate, never the exact file size, and must be recorded separately.

model.description: The exact production model used. A stub, fake detector, desktop/JVM execution, or emulator does not qualify.

preprocessing.description: Exact preprocessing applied to frames before inference, e.g. 'raw uint8 RGB, no normalisation'.

input.description: The fixed local input used for a latency run.

device.description: Present only for a physical-device run. Absent means no device was involved. Never record a serial number, IMEI, or any device identifier that identifies a person.

networkState.description: Network state during the run, recorded rather than assumed.

measurements.description: Every measurement block is required as a key, but each carries an explicit status. Use 'collected' with the data, or 'not_collected' with a reason. A measured value of zero is legal only when zero was genuinely measured.

notes.description: Limitations, deviations from the protocol, and anything a reader must know to interpret this record correctly.

reason.description: Why this measurement was not collected. Never a numeric value, 'N/A', or an empty string.

task.description: Gradle task, e.g. ':core:test'. Host test-suite time is never inference, app startup, or user-perceived latency.

seed.description: Fixed seed used by any generated test cases, e.g. '0xD15A0'.

generatedCaseCount.description: Number of generated cases the property test exercised.

cachePolicy.description: Cache state held constant across repeats.

repeats.description: One entry per independent execution. At least 3 are required for a reported comparison. Never present three calls inside one loop as three independent runs.

wallTimeMs.description: Host Gradle test-suite wall time in milliseconds, measured with a monotonic host timer. Informational only.

reportPath.description: Path to the retained test report for this repeat.

rehashMatched.description: Whether a repeated read confirmed the hash and byte count were identical, i.e. the artifact was not replaced mid-run.

measuredStage.description: Exactly what was timed, e.g. 'model invocation, model already loaded, fixed input tensor'. Keep model-only inference distinct from preprocessing, camera capture, and end-to-end timing.

unit.description: Unit of the recorded values, e.g. 'ms'.

timer.description: Timer or tool used, e.g. 'SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()' or 'Macrobenchmark'.

setupOutsideTimedRegion.description: Whether model load, decode, and setup were excluded from the timed region.

iterationsPerInvocation.description: For Macrobenchmark, at least 5 iterations per invocation.

repeats.description: At least 3 independent benchmark invocations. Report each repeat separately; a summary must not replace the per-repeat source results.

value.description: Measured value in the declared unit.

thermalStatusAtStart.description: Thermal status enum name before the repeat.

thermalStatusAtEnd.description: Thermal status enum name after the repeat.

rawOutputPath.description: Path to the preserved raw benchmark result or trace.

samples.description: Thermal status samples. A status is a platform throttling category, not a temperature in degrees Celsius. Do not substitute 'THERMAL_STATUS_NONE' for a sample that was never read.

offsetMs.description: Milliseconds relative to the start of the run.

statusName.description: Android thermal status enum name, e.g. 'THERMAL_STATUS_MODERATE'.
